description: My life benefits me . What a gift it is to be in control #selflove #selfmastery #selfpreservation
transcript: Every experience that I have is a benefit to me. Every experience that I have opens up a new door. Experiences have taught me that the deeper that I explore them, the more the truth of who I am is revealed to me. The more that I experience, the more control I gain. This life is not against me. This life is here to benefit me.
